summary: Defines Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution, which lets hosts resolve names on a local link when conventional DNS is unavailable. It supports DNS formats but uses a separate port and its own resolver cache. This memo is informational.

eli5.summary: If there is no phone book, you shout the name across the room and the right computer answers. LLMNR does that on a local network so machines find each other by name.

questions: name resolution without dns on local network
